name: EntitlementEntry
aliases: one-byte element of the entitlements run
summary: One element of the `entitlements` byte run: a single raw byte. The client reads and writes it through its raw one-byte stream slot, so the element is one u8 with no structure of its own.
purpose: Give the `entitlements` run a named element card so the container is counted(nested(...)) and the generated struct never declares a bare Vec<u8>.

fields.name: entitlement
fields.note: Read and written with the client's raw one-byte stream slot (writer vtable +0x40, reader 0x14087a330), inside the 0x14279ec10 element loop. The value's meaning is unnamed: the run is 423 bytes whose content no field boundary explains.

evidence.ref: 0x14279ec10 reads each element with the raw one-byte reader (build 30fe6461).
